quarterly_data.quarter: Wärtsilä press release: CMA CGM selects Wrtsil 34DF engines to support efficient, (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Marine order (release): Wärtsilä will supply 36 Wärtsilä 34DF dual-fuel engines, plus seals and bearings including its Airguard seal system, for 12 new 18,000 TEU LNG-fuelled container vessels being built for CMA CGM at the Jiangnan Shipyard in China; the engines are delivered through Wärtsilä's joint venture CWEC (Shanghai) Co. Ltd. The engine order for all 12 vessels was booked in Q1 2026; seals and bearings for the first four vessels in Q1 2026 and for the remaining eight in Q2 2026; delivery to the yard starts in 2027. CMA CGM already operates more than 160 Wärtsilä 34DF engines.
quarterly_data.figure: 36 Wärtsilä 34DF engines for 12 vessels; engines booked Q1 2026; delivery from 2027
